name: VIA Labs, Inc.
summary: VIA Labs, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the programming, designing, manufacturing, and sale of USB and USB power delivery controllers for multi-functional devices and platforms in Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, Japan, Europe, and internationally. The company offers host, hub, and SATA bridge controllers; USB type-C products, including electronic markers, display port alternate mode products, USB data switches, USB audio products, and re-drivers; power related IC products, such as USB-C DFP CC controllers, and USB PD wall adapters and sink controllers; USB4 endpoint devices; USB 2.0; and single stream transport video converters.
